# NeotixHQ

> An AI-native studio building cognitive systems that turn fragmented information, conversations, and workflows into structured context and better decisions.

NeotixHQ is a brand operated by [NuCielo ICT B.V.](https://nucielo.io/). The site outlines the studio's thesis on the cognitive layer of work: Information is abundant. Context is scarce.

[Meridian](https://meridian.neotixhq.com/) is a local-first AI History Explorer by NeotixHQ for importing, analyzing, searching, reading, and exporting ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini conversation history.

## Pages

- [Home](https://neotixhq.com/): NeotixHQ vision, principles, studio explorations, and contact.
- [Field Notes](https://neotixhq.com/field-notes): Studio articles and shared posts.

## Related sites

- [NuCielo ICT B.V.](https://nucielo.io/): Operator of the NeotixHQ brand.
